finding: Landmark-first encounters: bandit camp (2x2 fort, 14 NPCs, occurrences 50-100), Mi-Go camp with budget-costed raiders, spider pit lair (two layers, density 0.5 and 1), bandit and police roadblock map extras on roads; sometimes place nothing. Ambient walk density = per-terrain chance x world SPAWN_DENSITY knob. Escort template not found; patrol is an NPC mission-type name only.

Timed roadstop encounters: EOC recurrence 1800 with a 10 percent roll and a 7-day spawn tag; caravan (merchant plus two guards plus pickup), refugee group only before day 45, traveller camper van. Member windows by day and season in monstergroups (starts/ends/conditions).

Scale as data: 214 overmap specials (occurrence and city-distance weights), 16 with population and radius blocks (Mi-Go camp pop 20-50 radius 2-30; dermatik nest pop 10-20 radius 10-15; wasp towers pop 50-80 and 50-100; triffid grove pop 1000-1600). Monstergroup entries 360 in top-level files.

Half read (data plus three spawn call sites). Licence CC BY-SA 3.0 for code and content: inspiration category-level only, donor values null, no JSON copied. Not read: monster AI bodies, camp mapgen beyond counts, roadblock monster identities, robofac convoy ambush chunk, sounds.

Fixed count per level: 3 + (depth mod 5) + random 0-2, x1.33 on large feeling, depth 1 preset 8. Placed by room-size weight (1/2/3), entry clear zone of 8 tiles view and 8 steps walk, one-in-four second mob in a room. Foes drawn from a per-depth deck of hand-written families (depth 1 = 3 rats and a snake, shuffled and regenerated).

Respawn trickle: a wandering actor refills one foe at a time, only when below count, at path distance 12 or more from the hero, cooldown 50 (two-thirds in dark levels). Boss levels have no respawner (sewer, prison, city, halls, last level). Good model for a server-rolled refill that never spawns in view.

Vault patrol loop: four corner waypoints inset two cells, direction by coin flip, start at a random corner, set wandering; eight vault mob classes and seven call sites in six rooms. Detection is a facing cone (75 degrees within 6 tiles at 1/(d/2+stealth), 150 degrees at 1/(d+stealth), near zero outside). Changelog names it as wandering patrol routes.
